description: End this turn to await pending child completions, not submit a final result. Return completed work normally. Does not message other sessions. Omit waitFor when yielding for your own children; their completions resume this session. Set waitFor:"message" only when a subagent has no pending children and waits for its requester to send it a continuation.
name: sessions_yield

acknowledgment.description: Optional brief waiting status shown to the user as your message; put answers in normal assistant text.

message.description: Private context for the resumed turn; not sent to the user.

waitFor.description: Only for a subagent with no pending children of its own that waits for its requester to send it a continuation. Omit when yielding for your own children.
